article.title: Michael Carrick attends Manchester United training ground as club discuss his fate

article.content: Head coach arrives to watch under-21s play Bruno Fernandes likes Instagram post about loyalty Michael Carrick was at Manchester United’s training ground on Monday afternoon as elsewhere at the Carrington base Jason Wilcox, the sporting director, and Omar Berrada, the chief executive, deliberated whether to sack the head coach. Carrick arrived at about 1.50pm to watch the under-21s play a behind-closed-doors game. Continue reading...
